sbyang gzhi de dag sbyong byed kyi bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi sbyang gzhi'i lus la gnad du bsnun tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun chen pos/ gsum po re res kyang skye 'chi la sogs pa sbyong ba ni sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed thams cad ngo sprad pa/ lam thams cad gcig tu bsres nas ston pa 'di ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i bzhed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems can gyi skye shi bar do gsum ka bskyed rdzogs kyi lam gyi sbyang gzhir bshad pa ltar yin la/ de yang rnal 'byor pas 'chi ba'i rim pa la sbyang gzhir byas nas/ de sbyong byed kyi lam ye shes tshogs bsags stong nyid bsgoms nas sbyang 'bras chos sku mngon du byed la/ bar srid sbyang gzhir byas nas/ bar srid de nyid mtshon byed du/ gzhung kha cig tu lha gang yin pa de'i sa bon gyi yi ge tsam dang / kha cig tu bar de'i lus ngag yid gsum mtshon byed oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum dang / kha cig tu na da dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa dang / kha cig tu skyes bu'i gzugs su bsgoms pas sbyangs 'bras longs sku mngon du byed la/ skye srid sbyang gzhir byas nas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa la sogs pas/ sbyangs 'bras sprul sku mngon du byed par bshad pas bskyed rim rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung re res kyang skye shi bar do gsum ka sbyangs nas sku gsum mngon du byed par gsungs pa ltar yin no/ kha cig sa skya pa rnams kyis bskyed rim gyi lam gyis skye srid kho na sbyangs nas sbyangs 'bras sprul sku kho na mngon du byed par 'dod cing / 'chi srid dang bar srid sbyong bar mi 'dod par bshad pa ni cha med pa'i rgyus gtam kho na yin te/ rgyu mtshan rgyas par bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab tu bshad pa las shes par bya'o/ /de dag gis ni spyir gang la gnad du bsnun yul gyi sbyang gzhi ngos bzung ba mdor bsdus pa bstan zin nas/

gnyis pa bye brag tu sbyang gzhi'i gtso bo mngal skyes yin pa'i dbang du byas nas rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs bshad pa la bzhi/ sbyang gzhi'i gtso bo rdo rje lus kyi gnas tshul bstan pa/ de thog mar ji ltar grub tshul bshad pa/ bar du ji ltar gnas tshul bshad pa/ mtha' mar ji ltar 'jig tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ lus sems las skye tshul bshad pa dang / sbyang gzhi'i gtso bo mngal skyes kyi lus grub tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ rnam shes las ni skye ba rlung / /de las me ni skye bar 'gyur/ /de las chu ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de las skyes pa sa yin te/ /de rnams kun las phung po 'byung / /de las skye mched 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lus 'byung ba bzhi las skyes shing / 'byung ba gzhan gsum rlung las 'byung bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na sems rang nyid gang las skyes zhe na/ stong pa gsum gyi rten 'brel gyis skye ba yin te/ de ji ltar skye tshul ni rje btsun sku mched gnyis kas/ de la rnam par shes pa'i rgyun skye ba 'di yang rgyu du ma dang ldan/ rkyen du ma dang ldan te/ snga ma'i kun gzhi ni rgyu yin la/ las kyi bag chags bsgos pa ni rkyen yin no/ /bag chags zhes bya ba 'di ji ltar yin zhe na/ skye ba snga mar ma rig pa'i dbang gis las 'dus byas pas mngon par bsgos pa'i sems rig pa phyi mar mngon par skye bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa'o/ /des na kun gzhi'i skad cig snga ma 'gags pa ni 'od gsal bar gyur pa yin la/ de la bag chags kyi dbang gis kun gzhi da ltar ba skye ba ni stong pa chen po zhes bya'o/ /des bdag tu 'dzin pa nyon mongs pa can gyi yid skye ba ni shin tu stong nyid ces bya'o/ /de las rnam par shes pa tshogs drug stong pa'i bdag nyid skyes so/ /de ltar na ma rig pas rgyu dang / 'du byed kyi rkyen gyis las byas te rnam par shes pa gsum skye'o/

/de las ming dang / gzugs la sogs pa ji ltar skye zhe na/ rnam par shes pa de las rlung skye la/ de las me dang / chu dang / sa skye zhing / de las phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams skye'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa sbyang gzhi'i gtso bo mngal skyes kyi lus grub tshul bshad pa ni/ de la de'i skye ba snga ma gang 'gags pa yin kyang rung ste/ bar do'i skabs su brdzus te skye ba'i lus len la/ de mngal du 'jug pa na mngal skyes kyi lus grub pa yin no// ༈ //spyi don gnyis pa/ sbyang gzhi rdo rje'i lus 'di thog mar ji ltar grub tshul bshad pa la gnyis/ thog mar lus de gang las skye ba'i rgyu dang / rgyu de las lus de ji ltar grub tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ mngal du skye ba'i lus len pa na/ rgyu du ma dang rkyen du ma dang ldan dgos te/ de yang dri za nye bar 'khor ba ste/ rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ 'di ni rlung khams chen po ste/ /rnam shes gsum gyi bzhon pa yin/ /de ni de bzhin rtag tu ni/ /ji lta ji lta grol bar 'gyur/ /sra ba'i khams dang chu nyid dang / /de bzhin me dang rlung dag gis/ /rnam par shes pa blangs nas su/ /srid gsum gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bar do'i shes pa rlung la zhon te der 'ongs pa/ pha ma gnyis snyoms 'jug byed pa'i rtsa'i sgo gnyis la brten te thig le mnyam du 'bab pa/ las mnyam par bsags pa/ pho mo'i dbang gis pha ma la chags sdang gi nyon mongs pa skye ba'i rkyen dang / pha ma'i bde ba dang bar do'i shes pa sems snang ba gsum po ro gcig tu mnyam par gyur pa ste/ rgyu rkyen de rnams kyi rten 'brel 'dzoms pa las skye'o/ /gnyis pa rgyu rkyen de las lus de grub tshul la gnyis/ phra ba grub tshul dang / rags pa grub tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel de rnams 'dzoms pa'i dus su pha ma'i khu khrag dang rlung 'dres pa de'i tshe/

rlung gnas pa la brten te rnam par shes pa brgyal lo/ /de nas brtsams te/ rlung bcu rim gyis rgyas pas lus rgyas par byed pa ste/ de yang rlung gnas pa de la brten nas dkyil 'khor gsum dang rlung rnams rim gyis skyes te/ mer mer po la sogs pa'i dus su rlung gnas pa las rtsa a wa dhu ti dang khu khrag gnyis grub bo/ /de las rlung 'jug pa'i dbang gis rkyang ma grub la/ rlung ldang ba'i rim pas ro ma grub pas rtsa'i gtso mo gsum dang por grub bo/ /de bzhin du rtsa rnams dang / yi ge rnams dang / khams bdud rtsi rnams la 'phel zhing skye ba dang / 'pho zhing 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa lus rags pa grub tshul ni/ zla ba dang po la srog rlung ldang 'jug gnas pa la brten te nya'i rnam pa lta bur 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du zla ba gnyis pa la rus sbal gyi rnam pa lta bur yan lag lnga'i thad kar cung zad 'bur ba'o/ /gsum pa la phag rgod kyi rnam pa lta bur mgo cung zad mtho ba'o/ /zla ba bzhi pa dang lnga pa la ra ma gnyis kyi rnam pa lta bur yan lag gi tshigs rnams cung zad gsal ba'o/ /drug pa la nag pa'i rnam pa lta bur yan lag phal cher rdzogs pa'o/ /bdun pa la ni mi'i seng ge ste mgo bo seng ge'i rnam pa lta bur mgo bo gsal bar rdzogs pa'o/ /brgyad pa la/ mi'u thung gi gzugs lta bur grub pa'o/ /dgu pa la ngang pa lta bu ste mngal nas 'byung bar 'dod pa'o/ /bcu pa la sangs rgyas te sa bcu yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang he badz+ra las/ /zla ba bcu yang sa rnams te/ /sems can sa bcu'i dbang phyug go /'di dag rkyen gyis sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /ces gsungs pa la brten pa yin cing 'dir gnas skabs bcu la/ khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa bcu'i ming gis btags pa ni khyab 'jug gi rjes su 'brangs pa'i sems can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang /

dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las gsungs pa yin no// ༈ //spyi don gsum pa/ sbyang gzhi rdo rje'i lus 'di bar du ji ltar gnas tshul la/ dpal sam bu ṭi'i phyi ma las/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang / /bzhi stong gi ni cho gas kyang / /lus kyi de nyid mi shes pa/ /de dag thams cad 'bras bu med/ /ces gsungs la/ de'i don ni/ rim gnyis gnad du bsnun pa'i sbyang gzhi/ rdo rje lus kyi phra ba'i gnad bha ga la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gsum dang / de rnams la dbang byed pa'i rlung gi de nyid gnas tshul mi shes na bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i 'bras bu mi thob par gsungs pa yin pas/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum man chad kyi lam la/ dkyil 'khor gsum dang de la dbang du byed pa'i rlung gi gnad ma bstan pas/ de gsum man chad kyi lam gyis bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mngon du byed mi nus par yang bstan pa yin no/ /'o na 'di ji ltar gnad yin snyam na/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mngon du byed pa la bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin gyis sems 'dul bar byed dgos la/ de yang 'di ltar gdul bya'i sems rlung la gnas pas so/ /des na dkyil 'khor gsum gyi gtso bo spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo la sogs pa 'khor lo lnga dang / spyi gtsug dza len dha ra la sogs pa'i yul sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa na gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum/ de la dbang du byed pa'i rlung la gnad du bsnun pas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa thams cad nang du bskyed pa yin te/ de ji ltar skye tshul ni 'og sa lam gyi rnam gzhag 'chad pa'i skabs su rgyas par bshad par 'gyur ro/ /de la bar du sbyang gzhi rdo rje'i lus la gnas tshul gtan la dbab pa la gnyis/ sbyang gzhi'i lus kyi gnas tshul dkyil 'khor du bstan pa dang / dkyil 'khor de dag so so'i gnas tshul gtan la dbab pa'o/

/dang po ni/ dpal kha sbyor gyi phyi ma las/ dkyil 'khor lus su gsungs pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor bha gar brjod pa nyid/ /dkyil 'khor yang ni byang chub sems/ /dkyil 'khor gsum ni brtag par bya/ /zhes gsungs shing / de bzhin du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i phyi ma las/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor zhes grags dang / /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor dang / /lus kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bshad pa/ /gsum po dkyil 'khor yin par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rtsa lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor/ khams bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor te gsum po gsal bar gsungs pa yin no/ /'o na ci'i phyir dkyil 'khor zhes brjod snyam na thabs de la brten nas lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po de len pa ste 'dzin par byed pa'i phyir te/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa las/ dkyil ni snying po zhes bya ste/ /byang chub sems ni bde chen po/ /len par byed pas dkyil 'khor nyid/ /'dus pa dkyil 'khor nyid du brjod/ /ces gsungs shing / dpal kha sbyor las kyang / dngos po kun gyi snying po mchog /de nyid len pas gcod pa'i phyir/ /lus ni dkyil 'khor nyid du brjod/ /rtsa chen sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis/ /'khor lo yang ni dkyil 'khor brjod/ /byang chub sems ni rin po che/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid dkyil 'khor nyid/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /de la rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor zhes kyang bya ste/ 'jig rten na me grub na reg bya tsha ba rang gi ngang gis grub pa la tha snyad du me'i rang bzhin tsha ba zhes brjod pa ltar/ 'dir yang sbyangs gzhi'i lus de grub tsam nas dkyil 'khor gsum rang gi ngang gi grub pas de skad du brjod pa yin no/ /don 'di la dgongs nas/ grub chen dril bu pas/ 'gro ba 'di dag rang bzhin gyis/ /grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor de dag so so'i gnas tshul gtan la dbab pa la bzhi/

rtsa lus kyi dkyil 'khor gnas tshul gtan la dbab pa/ yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor gnas tshul gtan la dbab pa/ khams bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gnas tshul gtan la dbab pa/ dkyil 'khor de dag la dbang byed pa'i snying po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gtan la dbab pa'o/ /'di dag re re la yang phra rags kyi rim pa gnyis gnyis yod pas/ dang po rtsa lus kyi dkyil 'khor rags pa ni/ sha rgyus rkang rus la sogs pa dbang po'i rten khog pa dang bcas pa 'di nyid yin la/ phra ba ni rtsa'i rnam par gnas pa ste/ de yang dbu rkyang ro gsum la sogs pa rtsa'i gtso mo gsum dang / byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa'i rtsa'i gtso bo sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / yi ge bkod pa'i rtsa brgya nyi shu dang / yan lag gi rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa rtsa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnas pa la/ de la dang po thog mar gong du bshad pa ltar/ rlung gnas pa la brten nas rtsa a wa dhu ti grub cing / rlung nang du 'jug pa dang 'dzin rtog gnyis la brten te g.yon rkyang ma kha thur du blta ba gnas la/ rlung phyir 'gro ba dang gzung rtog la brten te g.yas ro mo kha gyen du lta ba gnas te/ 'di gsum ni rdo rje'i lus kyi rtsa rnams kyi gtso bo yin te/ he badz+ra'i le'u dang po las/ de rnams kyi nang nas rtsa rnam pa gsum ni gtso bo ste/ rkyang ma dang ro ma dang / kun 'dar ma'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa'i rtsa'i gtso bo sum cu rtsa gnyis ni/ dpal sam bu ṭi'i dang po'i rab byed gnyis par/ 'khor lo bzhi yi rab dbye bas/ /brgya phrag gcig dang nyi shu lhag /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin gyi/ /rtsa rnams sum cu rtsa gnyis mchog /ces gsungs pa ni 'di lta ste/ mi phyed ma zhes brjod pa dang / /zhes pa nas/ gtum mo dang bdud bral mo/ zhes pa'i bar gyis byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa'i rtsa'i gtso bo sum cu rtsa gnyis dang /

yi ge 'god pa'i rtsa nyi shu tsa gnyis bstan pa yin no/ /'o na dbu rkyang ro gsum mi phyed ma la sogs pa'i rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis la rtsa'i gtso bo zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ rtsa de rnams kyi nang na khams byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa'i phyir na der brjod pa ste/ gong du drangs pa ltar brtag gnyis las/ de rnams kyi nang nas rtsa rnam pa gsum ni gtso bo ste/ rkyang ma dang / ro ma dang / kun 'dar ma'o/ /rkyang ma mi bskyod 'bab ma ste/ /ro ma de bzhin khrag 'bab cing / /shes rab zla ba 'bab bshad pa/ /de ni kun 'dar ma rab grags/ /zhes gsungs pas na rgyu mtshan de'i sgo nas ro rkyang dbu gsum la gtso mor bshad pa yin la/ mi phyed ma la sogs pa'i rtsa lhag ma rnams la der bshad pa yang / sam bu ṭar/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin gyi/ /rtsa rnams sum cu rtsa gnyis mchog /ces rtsa de rnams kyi nang du byang chub kyi sems 'bab pas rtsa de rnams mchog ste/ gtso bor gsungs pa yin no/ /rtsa de rnams kyi nang du byang chub kyi sems sum cu rtsa gnyis 'bab par yang / he badz+ra las/ rtsa rnams ni sum cu rtsa gnyis te/ byang chub kyi sems sum cu rtsa gnyis 'bab pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de la brten pa'i yan lag gi rtsa stong phrag bdun bcu rtsa gnyis ni/ phyag rgya chen po thig le'i le'u bzhi par/ nyon cig lha mo skal chen mo/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo 'byung ba mchog /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su/ /rtsa rnams kyi ni rigs bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pas bstan to/ /'o na rtsa de rnams yul gang du gnas shing / byed las ci byed snyam na/ rtsa bu ma'i mas snas pha las thob pa'i khu ba 'dzin cing / yar snas ma las thob pa'i khrag 'thung nas mi g.yo bar byed do/ /ro rkyang gnyis kyi smad kha gnyis gnyis su gyes nas rkyang mas g.yon la brten nas khu ba 'phen 'dzin byed cing / mdun ngos nas dri chu 'phen 'dzin byed/

ro mas g.yas la brten nas khrag 'phen 'dzin byed/ rgyab ngos nas dri chen 'phen 'dzin byed pa ste/ dpal kha sbyor gyi drug pa'i dang po las/ rtsa gnyis skye gnas dbus su ni/ /g.yon dang g.yas dang de bzhin du/ /g.yon du khu ba rnams zhes bya/ /g.yas pa la ni khrag nyid de/ /gnyis pa 'dus pa'ang chos nyid sdud/ /ces gsungs pas bstan pa yin la/ sha chen gyi dwangs ma ni rtsa gsum ka'i stobs kyis 'dzin par byed pas/ byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa'i rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi nang nas rtsa 'di gsum gtso bor bshad pa'i don yang / 'di gsum gyis byang sems sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi gtso bo bdud rtsi lnga'i dwangs ma 'phen 'dzin byed cing / byang sems 'bab pa'i rtsa gzhan nyi shu rtsa dgu po de dag kyang rtsa gsum po 'di dag las 'phel ba dang / rtsa de rnams kyi nang du rgyu ba'i byang sems nyi shu rtsa dgu yod pa de yang byang sems sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi gtso bo rtsa ba'i bdud rtsi'i lnga'i dwangs ma 'phel ba yin pas de skad du brjod pa yin no/ /de bzhin du spyi bo pu li ra ma la sogs gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / de'i steng du nang gi yul brgyad bsnan pas yul sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / de'i steng du sbas pa'i rtsa lnga bsnan pas sum cu rtsa bdun du gnas pa'i rtsa khams kyi gnas tshul dang / de dag gi byed las dang / de rnams la gnad du bsnun pas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa yon tan skye tshul rnams ni 'og sa lam gyi rnam gzhag 'chad pa'i skabs su rgyas par brjod par 'gyur ro// ༈ //gnyis pa yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor gtan la dbab pa la yang phra rags gnyis las/ rags pa ni/ yab kyi rdo rje dang yum gyi pad ma yin la/ phra ba ni rtsa yi ge'i gzugs su gnas pa rnams te/ de yang rtsa ba'i yi ge lte ba'i a thung shad kyi rnam pa lta bu dang / e wam̐ ma ya'i yi ge bzhi dang / snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la sogs pa nang bskor gyi yi ge dgu dang /

phyi bskor gyi hūm̐ yig ring po brgyad dang / spyi bo na mi phyed ma pu'i gzugs su grub pa dang / de bzhin du yul nyi shu rtsa bzhir pu dza o ā la sogs pa'i nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / tshigs chen brgyad na gnas pa'i hūm̐ brgyad dang / mdor na rdo rje lus la gnas pa'i rtsa yi ge'i gzugs su grub pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnas pa rnams so// ༈ //gsum pa bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gtan la phab pa la phra rags gnyis las/ phra ba'am gtso bo ni khu khrag gnyis dang / bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma yul sum cu rtsa bdun gyi rtsa nang du rgyu ba rnams yin zhing / rags pa'am phal pa ni de las 'phel ba'i khams dwangs ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnas pa rnams so/ /bzhi pa dkyil 'khor gsum po de dag la dbang byed pa snying po ye shes rlung gi dkyil 'khor gtan la dbab pa la lnga/ rlung gi ngo bo/ dbye ba/ byed las/ rgyu tshul/ bsgom pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ spyir 'byung ba chen po'i khongs su 'du ba nyid yin la/ de yang phyi'i 'byung ba ma yin la/ byed pa thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i nang gi 'byung ba yin te/ dpal sam bu ṭi las/ de yi mgo bor brjod pa'i rlung / /ha ni kun tu 'gro bar brjod/ /ces gsungs pas rnam shes kyi rten du bstan no/ /gnyis pa dbye ba la gnyis/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba dang / byed las kyi sgo nas dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sam bu ṭa'i dang po'i drug pa las/ me nyid dang ni rlung nyid dang / /dbang chen dang ni de bzhin chu/ /'khor lo sems kyi kun spyod pa/ /steng dang 'og dang drang 'og 'gro /zhes gsungs pas/ 'byung ba bzhi dang / nam mkha' dang / rnam par shes pa'i rlung dang drug tu dbye bar bshad do/ /gnyis pa byed las kyi sgo nas dbye na/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang / yan lag gi rlung lnga dang rlung bcu te/ de rnams kyis ming ni/ rdo rje phreng ba las/ srog dang thur sel gyen rgyu dang /

/khyab dang mnyam gnas zhes bya dang / /klu dang rus sbal rtsang pa dang / /lha sbyin dang ni bzhu las rgyal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /de yang rlung de rnams dang / 'byung ba rnams phan tshun 'brel tshul ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo las ni/ thur sel zhes bya ye shes khams su 'gyur la srog rlung yang ni stong pa'o/ /rlung las yang ni mnyam gnas yin la slar yang me ni gyen rgyu khyab byed nyid ni chu yin no/ /klu ni sa yin rus sbal dang ni rtsang pa rlung dang lha sbyin dang ni nor las rgyal/ /bzhi po rlung dang me dang chu dang sa rnams la ni rim kyis kyang ni 'brang 'gyur te/ /zhes khams drug dang 'brel par gsungs la/ dpal kha sbyor gyi dgongs pa bla ma'i man ngag las byung ba srog 'dzin chu'i khams snying kha na gnas/ mnyam gnas sa'i khams lte ba na gnas/ thur sel rlung gi khams gshang lam na gnas/ gyen rgyu me'i khams mgrin par gnas/ khyab byed nam mkha'i khams lus khyab pa la gnas pa dang lnga ni rtsa ba'i rlung yin no/ /rgyu ba sa mig na/ mnyam rgyu chu rna ba na/ yang dag rgyu me sna na/ rab tu rgyu rlung lce la/ nges par rgyu nam mkha'i khams tshigs la gnas so/ /zhes gsungs la/ rlung de dag re re la yang 'byung ba lnga lnga'i bdag nyid gnas pa yin pas gong dus 'khor las bshad pa dang 'gal ba ni ma yin no// ༈ //spyi don gsum pa/ byed las byed tshul la gnyis/ spyir byed las byed tshul dang / so sor byed las byed tshul lo/ /dang po ni rnam par shes pa'i rten byed pa ste/ rdo rje phreng ba las sngar drangs pa ltar/ 'di ni rlung khams chen po ste/ /rnam shes gsum gyi bzhon pa yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa yin no/ /yang 'dis lus bskyed pa dang / 'phel bar byed pa la sogs pa'i bya ba byed de/ 'di ltar dang po rlung bskyed pa'i dus su ma'i mngal du rnam par shes pa rlung la bzhon nas zhugs pas/ rlung gnas pa la brten nas rnam par shes pa brgyal lo/

/de ye shes kyi rlung gi bdag nyid la gnas so/ /de nas srog rlung nas brtsam ste rlung bcu rim gyis rgyas pas lus rim gyis rgyas par byed cing / da lta lus gnas pa'i dus su rlung rgyu ba'i stobs kyis lus mi rngul bar 'dzin par byed cing / rlung ldang 'jug gi stobs kyis sems la rnam par rtog pa sna tshogs bskyed pa dang / de bzhin du 'chi ba'i dus su yang / rlung nam mkha' la thim pa la sogs pa rlung 'gags nas 'chi ba'i las byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa so sor byed las byed tshul ni/ dus 'khor las srog gi sde byed nyi zla'i lam 'gro thur sel thur du 'byin pas ro rnams ma lus la khyer mnyam gnas te/ /gyen du rgyu las lus bskyed pa ni kha dang lag pa rkang pa rnams kyang gar dang glu gar byed/ /khyab byed nad rnams skyed par byed de rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis lus 'khyog pa yang de bzhin no/ /klu yi sgrib pa nyid de lag pa dang ni rkang pa bskum pa rus sbal gyis/ /khro ba dang ni 'khrug pa ma lus rgyu ni rtsang pa yin la lha sbyin gyis ni gleng bar byed/ /lus la de nyid lnga po bral bar gyur gyi bar du mi bdag klu ni nor las rgyal/ /zhes gsungs la/ rdo rje phreng ba las/ srog rlung gis lus sems mi 'bral bar byed cing / sna sgor rgyu ba'i las byed/ thur sel gyis gshang gci la sogs thur du 'phen pa'i las byed/ mnyam gnas kyis kha zas 'ju ba la sogs pa'i las dang / dwangs ma lus la khyab par byed pa'i las byed/ gyen rgyus smra ba dang rgod pa dang skyug pa la sogs pa'i las byed/ khyab byed kyis 'degs pa dang 'jog pa la sogs pa'i las byed par bshad cing / yan lag gi rlung rnams ni mig la sogs pa'i sgo lnga nas byung nas gzugs la sogs pa yul rig pa'i las byed par bshad do// ༈ //spyi don bzhi pa rlung rgyu ba'i tshul la gsum/ rlung rgyu ba'i ngo bo ngos bzung ba/

de tshul ji ltar du rgyu ba/ gnas dang lam gang nas rgyu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni thur sel la sogs pa'i rlung dgu ni/ rang rang gi gnas nas rang rang gi las byed pa la rgyu ba zhes zer ro/ /srog rlung ni thog mar a wa dhu ti la gnas pa ye shes kyi rlung zhes bya la/ de bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sgo snying khar gnas nas ro rkyang gnyis kyi nus pas srog dang rtsol ba zhes bya ba ldang 'jug gnas gsum sna'i bu kha'i sgo nas rgyu ba yin te/ de yang sna'i bu kha'i sgo nas gsal bar rgyu ba ni srog rlung kho na ste/ phyag rgya chen po thig le dang rdo rje phreng ba gnyis ka las/ sna yi sgo yi rlung las ni/ /srog dang rtsol ba'i rgyu ba dag /dus kun tu ni rgyu ba ni/ /srog ces bya ba yin par bshad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'byung ba gzhan rnams kyi rlung sna'i bu kha nas mi rgyu ba'i skyon ni med de/ spyir rlung re re la'ang nang gses 'byung ba lnga lnga gnas pa yin la/ srog rlung ni rlung thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin zhing / 'byung ba lnga ka'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rlung de rnams tshul ji ltar du rgyu tshul la/ rnam shes kyi rlung ni ye shes kyi rlung yin la/ 'di ni rgyud kha cig las g.yon nas mi rgyu bar bshad kyang / bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ 'khor lo bzhi yi rab phye bas/ /thun bzhir byin gyis rlabs pa dang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /'di ni ji ltar bde bar rol/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mthun bzhi'i mtshams sam kun la khyab pa'i tshul gyis rgyu zhing / gsal bar ni mi rgyu bar bla ma'i man ngag gi de'i don du bshad do/ /nam mkha'i rlung ni de ltar gsal bar rgyu ba med cing / 'khor gyi tshul du rgyu la/ 'chi ba'i dus su ni 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung yang nam mkha'i rlung gis dbang byas te/ gtso bo'i tshul du rgyu ste rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ lus kun la ni khyab pa'i rlung /

/bya ba kun la 'jug pa ste/ /'di ni rnam snang ngo bo ste/ /'chi ba'i dus la 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don yin no/ /'byung ba bzhi'i rlung khog bzhi'i rgyu tshul bzhi 'byung ba ni/ sa rlung ser po sna'i bu ga gnyis ka nas rgyu ste/ rdo rje phreng ba las/ gnyis ka la ni 'byung ba'i khams/ /gser gyi mdog tu snang ba ste/ /dbang chen gyi ni dkyil 'khor nyid/ /rin chen mgon po'i rgyu ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yin la/ de nyid las/ dal zhing rgyu ba zhes bya'i khams/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor nyid yin te/ /dag pa shel ltar snang ba 'di/ /rdo rje mgon po'i rgyu ba'o/ /g.yas pa na ni 'byung ba'i khams/ /me yi dkyil 'khor nyid yin te/ /kha dog dmar zhing gsal ba 'di/ /pad+ma'i mgon po rgyu ba'o/ /g.yon pa na ni 'byung ba'i khams/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba/ /ljang ser du ba'i snang ba ste/ /las kyi mgon po'i rgyu ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ chu rlung ni sna'i bu ga gnyis ka nas dal zhing rgyu ba mi tshor ba dkar po rgyu ba dang / me rlung sna bug g.yas pa nas dmar po rgyu ba dang / rlung gi rlung sna bug g.yon pa nas ljang ser rgyu bar bshad pa ltar snang yang / rje btsun chen pos/ de ltar gsung sgros kyi sna bug tha dad par gsungs la/ kho bo'i rnam par rtog pas ni bu ga re re'i log g.yas g.yon la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin nam zhes bsam ste myong ba las grub bo zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa la gnas dang lam gang nas rgyu bshad pa ni/ de la spyir ye shes kyi rlung ni/ rtsa a wa dhu ti'i mas sna'i a thung bha ga'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa ni rlung kun gyi rtsa ba yin la/ de rtsa ro rkyang gnyis kyi dbang gis srog dang rtsol ba 'byung la/ de 'khor lo bzhi las/ snying kha'i rtsa 'dab bzhi las 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung du byas nas 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa 'dab rnams rim pa bzhin 'byung ste/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa kun 'byung ba bzhi'i bdag nyid mgrin pa nas byung ba ni/

gsung gi sgo bzhi zhes bya ba yin la/ mgrin pa na 'byung ba bzhi'i bdag nyid bshad pa ni/ de na 'byung bzhi'i son rtsa ya ra la wa bzhi'i yi ge gnas pas der bshad pa yin no/ /sna'i sgo gnyis nas 'byung ba ni/ thugs kyi sgo gnyis zhes bya la/ yan lag gi rlung phra mo rnams bu ga dgu nas rgyu ba'i sku'i sgo dgu zhes bya ste/ dpal kha sbyor gyi drug pa'i dang po las/ sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /mtha' ma 'bring po de bzhin nyid/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /'o na sna bug las grangs du zhig rgyu snyam na nyin zhag phrugs gcig la nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rgyu ste/ phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ thog mar 'byung dang rgyu ba'i grangs/ /nyi khri dang ni chig stong dang / /de bzhin grangs ni brgya phrag drug /nyin dang mtshan mor nges par rgyu/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang rlung phyir rgyu ba dang / nang du rngub pa dang / gnas pa dang gsum la gcig tu byas nas bsngo ba yin no// ༈ //spyi don lnga pa rlung bsgom pa'i phan yon la gnyis/ gnas skabs kyi phan yon dang / mthar thug gi phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ rlung bzung bas nad thams cad las grol zhing lus rgud pa dang / rgas pa'i nyes pa las grol ba dang / dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba bzlog pa'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa yin te/ shin tu spros med las/ 'di yi sbyor ba goms byas na/ /nad kun las ni grol 'gyur zhing / /'di ltar rgud dang rgas pa dang / /'chi bdag thag ring kun rtog 'joms/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang srog rtsol dang rdor bzlas bgrangs pas bzlas par 'gyur bas sgrib pa zad cing / rlung rnam pa lnga'i kha dog kyang gsal bas 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi yang 'bad med du 'grub par byed do/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor 'di goms pa las gnas skabs kyi phan yon brjod kyis mi lang ba snang ngo / /gnyis pa mthar thug gi phan yon ni/

de ltar rlung bzung ba dang bgrangs pas rnam par shes pa zin te/ rlung rnam shes kyi bzhon pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam shes zin pas zhi gnas skye zhing / de las rnam shes mi g.yo ba'i lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye la/ khyad par du de ltar rlung bzung ba dang / bgrangs pa la brten nas bde stong gi ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skye zhing / dkyil 'khor bzhi dbu mar thim pa'i rkyen gyis sa lam gyi rtogs pa rnams rim can du skyes nas/ mthar rlung sems thams cad kyi stobs sdom pa gtsug tor gyi dbu mar thim pa'i rkyen gyis bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mngon du byed pa yang 'di nyid kyis byed pa yin pa'i phyir ro// ༈ //spyi don bzhi pa/ sbyang gzhi'i lus kyi 'jig tshul bshad pa ni/ 'chi ba'i tshe sa chu la thim pas lus kyi stobs nyams/ chu me la thim ste lus kyi gsher ba'i dngos po skams/ me rlung la thim ste lus kyi drod yal/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pas dbugs rgyu ba chad/ rnam par shes pa 'od gsal la thim pa na 'chi ba zhes bya ba'i tha snyad byed pa yin zhing / de'i dus su bla ma'i gdams ngag yod na 'chi kha'i ye shes ngo 'phrod pa yin no/ /'di dag gi rnam gzhag rgyas par ni kho bos byas pa'i rdo rje lus kyi sbas bshad du blta bar bya'o/ /de yan gyis rdo rje lus kyi gnas tshul bshad pa/ de thog mar ci ltar grub tshul bshad pa/ bar du ji ltar gnas tshul bshad pa/ mtha' mar 'jig tshul bshad pa ste/ don bzhi'i sgo nas bye brag tu sbyang gzhi'i gtso bo mngal skyes yin pa'i dbang du byas nas rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs bshad pa bstan zin to// ༈ //spyi don gsum pa/ sbyong byed bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis lam gyi sbyang gzhi'i lus la gnad du bsnun tshul bshad pa la gnyis/ bskyed rim gyis gnad du bsnun tshul bshad pa dang / rdzogs rim gyis gnad du bsnun tshul bshad pa'o/

/dang po la gsum/ phyi'i bskyed rim gyis brgyud nas gnad du bsnun tshul bshad pa dang / nang gi bskyed rim gyis dngos su gnad du bsnun tshul bshad pa dang / zhar byung rang nyid bsgom bya'i lha de nyid yin min gyi mtha' dpyad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po sbyor ba sngon 'gro la yang gsum/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags dang / ye shes kyi tshogs bsags dang / bar chad zhi ba'i phyir bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la rgyas par byed na/ rdo rje gur las/ bla ma rdo rje can mchod nas/ /bdun po yongs su dag par bya/ /zhes dang / tshangs pa'i gnas ni bzhi po yis/ /sems kyi ngal ni gso bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gzhir byas pa'i steng du tshogs zhing spyan drangs te phyag dang mchod pa bya ba dang / sdig bshags la sogs rgyun bshags dang / tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa yin la/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung bar bshad pa rnams kyang yan lag bdun pa'i khongs su bsdu'o/ /'bring du byed na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / tshad med bzhi bsgom pa yin la/ bsdus nas byed pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas nas ye shes tshogs bsags bsgom pa yin no/ /de la sngon 'gro 'bring po byed pa la/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa yan chad las/ bsrung 'khor bsgom pa med do/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la rgyud so so'i dgongs pas/ ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi bcing ba/ yan lag drug gi bcing ba/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i bcing ba dang gsum du bshad pa las/ dang po gnyis ni dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la sbyar ba'i mngon rtogs yin pas/ re zhig mi spro la/ 'dir bskyed rim mtha' dag la 'jug pa bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i bcing ba'i man ngag 'di bshad pa'i gzhi yin pa las/ de yang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i le'u bcu gnyis pa las/ bsnyen pa'i dam tshig sbyor ba dang /

/nye bar bsgrub pa 'byung ba dang / /bsgrub pa'i don gyi dam tshig dang / /bsgrub pa chen po dag dang bzhi/ /zhes bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i rkang drangs gsungs shing / bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i ngos 'dzin ni yang de nyid las/ bsnyen pa'i dam tshig rab sbyor ba/ /byang chub sems ni bsgom par bya/ /zhes dam tshig pa bskyed pa bstan cing / nye bar bsgrub pa sgrub mchog la/ /rdo rje skye mched rnam par dpyad/ /ces skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa bstan la/ sngags kyi bdag po bsgom pa yis/ /bsgrub pa'i tshe na bskul bar gsungs/ /zhes pas/ ye shes pa gzhug pa bstan/ sgrub pa chen po byed pa'i tshe/ /dbu rgyan la ni bdag po bsam/ /zhes dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab pa bstan pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis ni bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i bsgom tshul gsungs pa yin no/ /'di la'ang rgyas bsdus gsum du byed pa'i lugs las rgyas par byed na/ yan lag bzhi'i bskyed nas mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba yan chad bya ba yin la/ 'bring du byed na ni yan lag bzhi'i bskyed nas mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba rnams mi byed par bzlas pa la 'jug pa yin no/ /de nyid bsdus pa ni/ skye mched byin gyis mi rlobs par/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ dbang mi bskur bar dbu rgyan rang chas su bsgom pa'i yan lag bzhi'i bskyed nas bzlas pa la 'jug pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i dngos gzhi la dam tshig pa bskyed chog gi tshul mi 'dra ba mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa dang / rdo rje cho ga gsum las bskyed pa dang / snying po tshig tsam las bskyed pa dang / dbugs kyi spro bsdu las bskyed pa dang bzhi bshad pa las/ 'dir sbyang gzhi'i gtso bo mngal nas skyes pa'i rim pa sbyong zhing / rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor gyi sbyang gzhi lus la gnad du bsnun nas bde stong gi ye shes dngos su bskyed pa'i dge rtsa smin byed kyi rgyur 'gyur tshul bshad dgos pas/

mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa ni bskyed rim de rnams kyi gtso bo yin no/ /'o na de nyid 'dus pa la sogs rnal 'byor rgyud du mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor bshad pas/ 'dir bshad pa'i mngon byang lnga dang khyad par yod dam med/ yod na 'di 'dra'o zhes bshad dgos la/ med na bla med nas bshad pa'i bskyed chog de/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi lam las zab pa'i lam gyi zab khyad du bshad pa dang / sbyang gzhi mngal skyes bskyed rim gyi sbyong ba dang / rdzogs rim gyi dge rtsa smin byed kyi rten nam rgyu byed pa ji ltar yin zhe na/ 'di la bshad par bya ste/ bla med nas bshad pa'i mngon byang lnga'i bskyed chog dang / rnal 'byor rgyud nas bshad pa'i mngon byang lnga rnams de ltar ming dang rnam pa 'ga' zhig 'dra yang / don mi 'dra ste/ 'di ltar bla med nas bshad pa'i mngon byang lnga las/ dang po nyi zla bsgom pa'i mngon byang ni ngo bo lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po bskyed pa'i rgyu khyad par can byang sems dkar po mtshon don du rnam pa nyi zla'i rnam par bsgom pa yin la/ rnal 'byor rgyud du nyi zla bsgom pa'i mngon byang la ni/ spyir thabs shes tsam mtshon pa ma gtogs lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po skyed par byed pa'i rgyu khams dkar dmar gyis mtshon don du 'gro ba'i don yod pa ma yin no/ /rgyud der lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba skyed par byed pa'i thabs khyad par can khams dkar dmar gyi mtshon don ni/ nyi zla'i rnam par bsgom pa la dbang ba'i lhan skyes kyi bde ba skyed par byed pa'i dbang bskur ba med la/ dbang bskur ba de med na/ de yod pa'i don med pa'i phyir te/ shes rab dang thabs yang dag par sbyor ba nyid ni/ de yongs su gsal lo/ /zhes bde ba chen po 'di nye bar ston to/ /de nyid kyi phyir rgyud gzhan rnams su zla ba la sogs pa'i rim pas rnam pa lngar byang chub par gsungs na'ang /

bde ba chen po'i tshul nyid du nye bar ston pa ni ma yin no/ /rnam pa 'di lta bu'i rnal 'byor dang / rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kho nar ni bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa yongs su gsal zhing / de'i rjes su 'brangs pa las gzhan du yongs su rtogs par bya'o/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i dbang med par nye bar bstan pa ma yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' kho na'o/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i dbang rnams sa 'di lta bu'i rgyud kho nar ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag gi rgyu mtshan rgyas par ni 'og yan lag gi don gyi bskyed rim bsgom pa'i tshul 'chad par bya ba'i skabs su bshad par bya'o/ /des na bla med kyi rim pa dang po'i skabs su mngon byang lnga'i rnam gzhag gi gnad legs par ma rtogs na bla med kyi phyi'i bskyed rim gyi rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas tshul la rgyud nas gnad du bsnun tshul mi shes la/ de ma shes na bskyed rim de sbyang gzhi mngal skyes kyi gnyen por 'gro tshul mi shes pas/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi mngon byang las khyad par du 'phags pa'i 'phags chos mi shes par/ de dang khyad par med par go ba gcig 'ongs pa yin no// ༈ //spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ste/ rdzogs par byed pa'i yan lag ni/ bzlas pa dang / spyod lam dang / kha zas dang / gtor ma dang / khrus dang / thun mtshams kyi bya ba dang / nyal ba dang / ldang ba dang / dag pa dran pa rnams yin no// ༈ //spyi don gnyis pa/ nang gi bskyed rim gyi sbyang gzhi rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas tshul la/ dngos su gnad du bsnun tshul la yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba dang / rjes kyi bya ba gnyis ni/ phyi'i bskyed rim gyi skabs dang khyad par med do/ /'dir dngos gzhi la gsum/ nang gi bskyed rim gyi sgra don bshad pa/ sgra don dang ldan pa'i bskyed rim gyi sbyang gzhi la dngos su gnad du bsnun tshul bshad pa/

de ltar gnad du bsnun pa'i bskyed rim bsgom pa de nyid phyi'i bskyed rim las khyad par du 'phags tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phyi'i dam tshig pa bskyed pa'i cho ga mngon byang lnga la sogs pa rang rang gi gzhung nas bshad pa'i sgrub thabs gang rung gi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sam/ dpa' bo gcig pa gang rung bskyed pa'i gtso bo lus la nang gi bskyed rim gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bskyed pa yin la/ de'i bskyed gzhi ni sgrub pa po'i lus kyi nang gi char gtogs pa'i sha rus pags gsum/ rtsa thig rlung gsum la sogs pa'i lus po'i cha shas rnams rgyur byas pa las rten gzhal yas khang dang / brten pa lha rnams bskyed pa dang / de nyid rim gyis gsal btab nas bsgom par bshad pas de nyid la nang gi bskyed rim zhes bshad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa sgra don dang ldan pa'i bskyed rim bsgom pas sbyang gzhi lus kyi gnas tshul la gnad du bsnun tshul bshad pa ni/ de yang sgrub pa po'i lus kyi pags pa dang / ba spu la sogs pa tshun cad kyi lus kyi cha shas phra rags rnams rgyur byas nas rang rang gi gnas de dang der rten gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod bcas pa dang / brten pa lha gtso 'khor yab yum rnams bskyed nas sbyang gzhi de nyid sbyong bar byed pa yin no/ /'di la yang phra rags kyi rim pa gnyis yod pa las/ rags pa ni dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i lus dkyil bsgrub tshul lta bu phung khams skye mched rags pa tsam zhig lhar bskyed pa dang / srung 'khor dur khrod bskyed pa med par lus gzhal yas khang tsam du bskyed nas/ nang gi sbyang gzhi sbyong bar byed pa'i nang gi bskyed rim bsgom tshul rags pa dang / bskyed rim de nyid phra bar bsgom tshul ni/ lus la brten nas gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dang bcas pa bskyed nas de'i nang du nang gi yul sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / phyi rtsa khams brten pa lhar bskyed pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi lus dkyil bsgom tshul dang /

dpal kyai rdo rje'i lus dkyil/ rtsa 'khor lo rnams kyis rtsa khams lhar bskyed pa la/ 'khor lo drug la gnad du bsnun nas de'i rtsa thig rnams lhar bsgom pa rdo rje snying 'grel dang / gnyug ma dran gsal las bshad pa lta bu/ 'khor lo lnga la gnad du bsnun te/ de'i rtsa khams lhar bskyed nas bsgom pa grub chen bir+wa pa'i man ngag grub chen dgra las rnam rgyal gyis phyag rgya bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa lta bu rnams yin no/ /gsum pa de ltar gnad du bsnun pa'i bskyed rim bsgom pa de nyid/ phyi'i bskyed rim las khyad par 'phags tshul bshad pa la gnyis/ rdzogs rim gyi dge rtsa smin par byed tshul gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags par bshad pa dang / sbyang gzhi sbyong tshul gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni phyi'i bskyed rim gyi mngon byang lnga'i skabs su/ bde ba chen po mtshon byed du nyi zla bsgom pa'i mngon byang la sogs pas/ rdzogs rim gyis dge rtsa brgyud nas smin par byed pa yin la/ nang gi bskyed rim 'di lta bus ni rdzogs rim gyis dge rtsa dngos su smin par byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ de yang 'di ltar rdzogs rim la bdag byin gyis brlabs pa dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rim pa gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pas rtsa 'khor lo bzhi dang / lus kyi gnas sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa'i rtsa dang khams dang / rlung rnams la gnad du bsnun te/ lte ba dang snying kha la sogs pa de dag gi gnas rnams su/ thig le dang / yig 'bru dang / rlung dang gtum mo'i me rnams bsgom ste 'bar 'dzag la sogs pa la dmigs nas bde stong gi nyams myong bskyed pa yin la/ 'dir yang gnas de rnams su rtsa thig rlung la sogs pa rgyur byas nas lhar bskyed pas rtsa thig rlung gsum rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs te las rung du byas pas rdzogs rim gyi dge rtsa bde stong gi nyams myong bskyed pa la dngos su phan pas khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/

/gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi rim pa la/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi lam dang dbang bzhi pa'i lam gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni las kyi phyag rgya la brten nas byang sems spyi bo nas gsang gnas 'khor lo'i bar du phabs nas yas 'bab kyi dga' ba bzhi'i rtogs pa khyad par can bskyed pa gcig yod la/ de'i bar chad kyi bdud ni 'dzag dgra yin zhing / 'dzag pa'i sgo ni dbang po'i sgo'i rtsa rnams yin la/ 'dir dbang po'i rtsa khams rnams las sems dpa' dang / sems ma dang / khro bo dang / khro mo la sogs pa'i skye mched kyi lha rnams bskyed de/ 'dzag pa'i sgo rnams bkag ste mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs nas 'dzag pa'i dgra las rgyal bar byed pa'i sgo nas rdzogs rim gyis ye shes skye ba'i dngos rgyu byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa dbang bzhi pa'i lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs ni 'di nyid kyi skabs su yang / las kyi phyag rgya la brten nas mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi bskyed pa la/ gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo'i byang sems rnams rlung gi sbyor bas gyen du bzlog ste/ rtsa 'khor rnams rim pa bzhin du gang nas spyi bo'i bar du slebs par byas nas lus thams cad la khyab par byas pas/ nang du mas brtan gyi lhan cig skyes pa'i bde bas rgyud gang zhing / phyi ru gser 'gyur gyi rtsis lcags la sogs pa bem po phal pa rnams la reg pas gang reg de gser du 'gyur ba bzhin du/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsi dang 'dra ba'i mas brtan gyi khams dwangs ma de lcags dang 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i lus la reg pas pra se na dbab pa bzhin du 'ja' tshon ltar 'gyur ba yin la/ de'i bar chad kyi gegs ni rtsa gnas phra mo rnams su khams dwangs ma mi 'drongs pa dang / khyad par du gsang gnas nas gyen du bzlog ma nus pa der lus te dri chu dang 'dres nas song na/ lam gyi gegs chen po yin la/ de la nang gi bskyed rim kyi skabs su/

byang chub kyi sems g.yo ba'i 'khor lo bcu la sogs pa'i tshigs mtshams rnams su kun bzang la sogs pa'i sems dpa' rnams dang / bgegs mthar byed la sogs pa'i khro bo rnams bsgoms pas rlung sems rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs su byang sems gyen du bzlog nus pa la sogs pa'i dngos rgyu byed pa yin no/ /gsum pa zhar byung rang nyid bsgom bya'i lha de yin min gyi mtha' dpyad pa la gnyis/ rang lugs bshad pa/ de la rtsod pa spong ba'o/ /dang po ni rje btsun rtse mos/ rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ji ltar grub snyam pa la/ 'khor lo gsum gyi rten gyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis lus la grub ste/ dpal kha sbyor gyi thig le las/ rkang pa'i mthil du rtsom chen rlung / /zhes bya ba nas/ lus ni dkyil 'khor nyid du brjod/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs pas rten grub la/ dkyil 'khor gyi rten la lha rnams kyang 'grub ste/ lus kyi rtsa dang khams dwangs ma lha'i ngo bo yin te/ 'di dag gnas su mkha' 'gro ma/ /rtsa gzugs mdzes par yang dag gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa'o zhes dang / de bzhin du rang nyid bsgom bya'i lha kyai rdo rje la sogs pa yin nas bsgom pa yin par rje btsun gong mas zhal gyis bzhes pa yin la/ gnyis pa de la rtsod pa spong ba la gnyis/ rtsod pa'i ngag 'god pa dang / rtsod pa de spong ba'i sgo nas rang lugs rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs par bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po la kha cig mkhas grub dge legs dpal ba/ 'di skad zer te/ 'ga' zhig 'gro ba rnams 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du rang bzhin gyis grub pa yin na/ de yi rang bzhin mi shes rnams/ /snod du bya bar bzhed pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa mi rigs te/ bde mchog rang gi lus dkyil du/ grub pa mi shes pa 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes zer ro/ /de'i don gsal bar bya ba'i phyir du rgyud don la tshod bzo byed pa'i rtog ge pa kha cig 'di skad du smra bar byed de/

bod kyi bla ma kha cig na re/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas/ 'gro ba 'di dag rang bzhin gyis/ /grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa/ /zhes dang / lus dkyil ni ma bcos pa'i dkyil 'khor du gsungs pas/ 'gro ba thams cad kyis lus gdod ma nas dkyil 'khor du yod pa la yod par ngo ma shes pa shes par bya ba'i phyir du sngar yod gsal gdab pa'i tshul gyis bsgom pa yin no zhes zer ro/ /'di ltar smra ba ni ha cang yang ma brtags pa'i log par rtog pa yin te/ de ltar na 'gro ba rnams kyi lus las dang nyon mongs pas bskyed pa'i du kha bden pa ma yin pa'am/ rdo rje 'chang gi dkyil 'khor las nyon gyi dbang gis grub pa yod par thal ba'i phyir dang / rdo rje 'chang dngos kyang yin/ 'khor ba pa yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa yod pa tsam du yang ma zad/ 'khor ba'i du kha myong ba'i sems can yin na rdo rje 'chang yin pas khyab par 'gyur te/ lus sems kyi cha gang yang dkyil 'khor gyi cha der ma bsgoms pa med la/ de thams cad kyi cha de dkyil 'khor pa dngos yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta na ni sgrib pa yin na ye shes su 'dod dgos la/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas dngos yin na/ snod kyi 'jig rten ye shes rang snang gi gzhal yas khang dngos ma yin pa 'gal bas/ 'khor ba shes bya la mi srid par thal zhing / rang nyid sangs rgyas yin pa la yin par ngo ma shes pa'i sangs rgyas des ni rang yang ma shes na thams cad mkhyen pa lta zhog de bas na shes bya gang yang mi mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas shin tu blun pa de lta bu ni ches ya mtshan no/ /gzhan yang de ltar 'dod pas ni sangs rgyas yin pa la yin par ngo shes phyin chad lam bsgom pa'i dgos pa ci yang med par 'dod dgos pas/ lus dkyil lan gcig brda' 'phrod phyin chad lam gang yang bsgom mi dgos par 'gyur ro/ /des na 'di ltar smra zhing lam bsgom nas sa lam rim can du bgrod par 'dod pa ni rig pa rnal du ma bzhag pa yin la/

phar phyin gyi lam gyi thob bya mthar thug par bshad pa'i bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa thob kyang / da dung sngags kyi rdo rje 'chang las ches dman par khas blangs nas/ sems can thams cad rdo rje 'chang gi dkyil 'khor dngos su gdod ma nas grub par khas len pa 'di las ngo mtshar du gyur pa ci zhig byar yod/ gal te 'gro ba rnams kyis lus sems kyi cha de dang de la dkyil 'khor gyi cha de dang de mi gsal zhing mngon du ma gyur pa'i tshul gyis gdod ma nas yod pa la bsgom stobs kyis mngon du gyur par byed pa yin no zhe na/ rgyu la 'bras bu'i cha thams cad gdod ma nas mi gsal ba'i tshul gyis dngos su yod par 'dod pa grangs can gyi ring lugs gra ma nyams par 'ong ba yin no/ /gzhan yang 'gro ba thams cad kyi lus la gdod ma nas dkyil 'khor dngos su yod na srog gcod pa'i las yin na de bzhin gshegs pa bkrongs ba'i mtshams med yin dgos par 'gyur ba dang / mi dge ba bcu byed pa po thams cad sangs rgyas su thal ba la sogs pa mtha' yas mod/ zad par brjod kyis ga la lang / yang kha cig bskyed rim gang bsgoms thams cad phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad gzhal yas khang dang / nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad lhar gdod ma nas gnas pa ngo ma shes pa shes par bya ba'i phyir bsgom pa yin no/ /zhes zer ba yang rigs pa 'di dag gis dgag par bya ste/ phyogs 'di la sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i snod bcud mi srid par 'dod dgos pas/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi rnam gzhag kyang mi 'thad par 'gyur la/ sems can thams cad rdo rje 'chang sha stag yin pas/ sngags spyod kyi skal ba dang ldan mi ldan gyi rnam 'byed med par 'gyur zhing / nyon mongs pa shes bya la srid ma myong bas lam rim pa gnyis bsgom pa don med sogs su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes zer ro/ /gnyis pa rtsod pa de spong ba'i sgo nas rang lugs rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs par bsgrub pa la gsum/

sems can thams cad kyai rdo rje la sogs pa'i lhar gdod ma nas yod tshul spyir bshad pa/ bye brag tu dkyil 'khor bzhi ldan gyi 'gro ba rnams kyi lus dkyil 'khor du grub tshul bshad pa/ g.yo rgyu'i rtsod pa de nyid rang lugs dang 'gal tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ khyod kyi nyon mongs pas kun nas bslangs te brjod pa'i thal 'gyur 'di rnams kyi phyogs sngar bkod pa'i grub mtha' 'di su zhig khas len par sems nas skyon de rnams brjod pa yin/ nged kyi rje btsun gong ma yab sras rnams kyis sems can rnams kyai rdo rje sogs su bshad pa yang / kyai rdo rje sogs la gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi kyai rdo rje sogs kyi rnam gzhag byas pa'i gzhi'i kyai rdo rje sogs yin par bshad pa yin la/ de rnams skyon kun zad dang / yon tan kun ldan gyi 'bras dus kyi rdo rje 'chang chen po yin par gang du smras/ nyon mongs pa'i dug chu snyog ma can ring du spongs la smros shig des na don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na/ nged kyi rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos/ rgyu rgyud kyi nges tshig bzhag pa'i skabs su/ de la rgyu zhes bya ba ni da lta dngos su med kyang rkyen dang 'phrad na 'bras bu skye rung gi nus pa la bya ste/ dper na snod na gnas pa'i sa bon lta bu'o/ /de bas na rang gi sems 'di da ltar sangs rgyas dngos su ma 'grub kyang / thabs dang 'phrad na sangs rgyas 'byung bas sangs rgyas kyi rgyu zhes bya ste/ zhes dri bcas kyi sems rig cing gsal ba tsam du yod pa 'di/ 'bras dus kyi sangs rgyas kyi rgyu yin pas rgyu rgyud du bshad la/ yang 'di nyid kyi rgyud kyi mtshan don bstan pa'i skabs su/ de la re zhig kyai rdo rje'i rgyud bya ba ni/ rgyud las/ he ni snying rje chen po nyid/ /badz+ra shes rab brjod par bya/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rgyud/

/de ni nga yis bshad kyi nyon/ /zhes gsungs pa ste/ kyai ni snying rje ste thabs yin la/ rdo rje ni de dang 'dra bas shes rab bo/ /de bas na sangs rgyas rnams kyi dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang / shes rab chen po zung du chud pa la kyai rdo rje ste 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /de lta bu'i 'bras bu thob pa yang kyai rdo rje/ de'i rgyu yang kyai rdo rje yin dgos pas rgyud gsum ka kyai rdo rje 'o/ /rgyu'i kyai rdo rje/ rgyu rgyud thabs shes gnyis su med pa gang yin zhe na/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ shes rab thabs ni snyoms 'jug pa/ /rnal 'byor zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /gang zhig dngos med shes rab ste/ /thabs ni dngos po'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pas dngos po'i gzung ba dang 'dzin pa sna tshogs su snang bas thabs te 'khor ba dang / de nyid kyi tshe ngo bo spros pa mtha' dag dang bral bas mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /de gnyis dbyer med pa ni rgyu'i rgyud kyi kyai rdo rje'o/ /zhes pa nas 'bras bu'i rgyud kyi kyai rdo rje'i bar gsal bar gsungs la/ de las gzhan pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi lus gdod ma nas 'bras dus kyi rdo rje 'chang gi dkyil 'khor du yod ces pa dang / sems can rnams 'bras dus kyi kyai rdo rje la sogs pa'i lhar gdod ma nas gnas pa yin zhes/ gang du smras rig pa rnal du zhog la smos shig mdor na rje btsun chen pos rnam bshad dag ldan du/ kha cig 'di skad du/ zla ba la sogs pa 'di dag me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pa yin nas bsgom pa'am ma yin kyang bsgom/ dang po ltar na grub zin sgrub par 'gyur la/ gnyis pa ltar na/ sprang po rgyal por rlom pa ltar/ bsgoms kyang mi 'grub bo snyam na/ yin nas bsgom pa 'di la yang 'bras bu dngos yin pa dang / chos nyid dam rnam pa yin pa gnyis las/ chos nyid dam rnam pa yin la/ zhes de dag 'bras dus kyi yin pa'i dogs spong dang bcas pa gsal bar mdzad pa ma yin nam/

kyai rdo rje la sogs pa la gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag byed par ni khyod rang gi yang 'dod pa yin te/ ji skad du/ bla med kyi rgyud kyi don gyi gnad thams cad/ e wam̐ la sogs pa'i yi ge bzhi bcu'i gleng gzhi'i don du 'dus la/ de'i don gyi gtso bo yang thog ma'i yi ge gnyis kyi don du 'du ba yin no/ /de la rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ zhes rgyud kyi lung drangs nas/ de'i don khyod kyis bshad pa na/ dang po'i lan du e wam̐ kyi don gsum gsungs pa ni thob bya 'bras bu'i e wam̐/ thob byed lam gyi e wam̐/ 'dren byed rtags kyi e wam̐ mo/ zhes e wam̐ la rgyu dang / lam dang / 'bras bu'i e wam̐ gsum du dbye bar bshad cing / des na thams cad kyai rdo rje la sogs pa'i lhar gdod ma nas gnas pa'i tshul ni/ rgyud don la tshad mar gyur pa shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po rnams kyis rgyud kyi bshad srol rnam par 'byed pa'i tshe/ rgyud sde gang bshad kyang brjod bya don gyi rgyud dang rjod byed sgra'i rgyud gnyis su phye zhing / brjod bya don gyi rgyud la yang rgyud gsum du bzhag pa yin pas/ de yang kyai rdo rje lta bu gcig la mtshon te bshad pa na/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa las/ he yi rnam pas ji zhig bshad/ /badz+ra yis kyang de bzhin ci/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /he ni snying rje chen po nyid/ /badz+ra shes rab brjod par bya/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rgyud/ /de ni nga yis bshad kyi nyon/ /ces gsungs pa yin la/ de la kyai rdo rje la sogs pa'i rgyud de la yang / rjod byed sgra'i rgyud dang / brjod bya don gyi rgyud gnyis yod pa'i phyi ma dang / kyai rdo rje dang / 'khor lo bde mchog dang / rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa rnams don gcig cing / de yang thabs shes gnyis su med pa la bshad de/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ rdo rje mi phyed ye shes te/

/sems dpa' snying rjer ston pa'o/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu grags/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de yang gzhi lam 'bras gsum so so'i skabs kyi bsdus pa yin te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i phyi ma las/ rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes byar grags/ /rgyud de rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /gzhi dang de yi rang bzhin dang / /mi 'phrog pa yi rab phye ba/ /rnam pa'i rang bzhin rgyu yin te/ /de bzhin mi 'phrog 'bras bu'o/ /gzhi ni thabs zhes bya ba ste/ /gsum gyi rgyud kyi don bsdus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bshad bya'i rgyud de nyid rgyu rgyud dang / thabs rgyud dang / 'bras bu'i rgyud gsum gyis bsdus par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang gzhi'i rgyud dam gzhi dus kyi kyai rdo rje dang 'khor lo bde mchog la sogs pa ni snang stong zung 'jug thabs kyi rgyud dam lam dus kyi kyai rdo rje la sogs pa ni thabs shes zung 'jug 'bras bu'i rgyud dam 'bras dus kyi kyai rdo rje la sogs pa ni sku gnyis zung 'jug gam sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan no/ /de la gzhi'i kyai rdo rje snang stong zung 'jug ni sems can gyi sems gsal rig tsam du gnas pa ni snang ba'i thabs yin zhing / de nyid spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba ni stong pa'i shes rab yin te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i phyi ma las/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/ /rnal 'byor zhes ni bya ba yin/ /gang gi dngos med shes rab la/ /thabs ni dngos po'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /de gnyis zung du 'jug pa ni/ snang stong gnyis po'i ngo bo dbyer med pa'i cha la zung du 'jug par bshad pa yin te/ 'phags pa'i rim lnga las/ snang ba dang ni stong pa gnyis/ /so so'i char ni shes gyur nas/ /gang du yang dag 'dres gyur kyang / /zung du 'jug par de bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na gzhi'i kyai rdo rje'i dbang du byas nas/

grub chen mtsho skyes kyis/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /kyai rdo rje bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / dpal brtag pa gnyis pa las/ sangs rgyas ma yin sems can ni/ /gcig kyang yod pa ma yin no/ /dmyal ba yi dwags byol song dang / /lha dang lha min mi rnams dang / /bshang ba'i srin bu la sogs pa/ /lha dang lha ma yin gyis kyang / /bde ba gang gis mi shes pa/ /rtag tu rang bzhin bde ba can/ /'jig rten khams ni gang du yang / /sangs rgyas gzhan du rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sems ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du bstan du med/ /ces gsungs shing / rdo rje snying 'grel las/ gzhan yang rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i dbugs 'byin pa 'di ni/ skye bo rnams la sna tshogs pa'i dngos por snang ste/ 'di lta ste/ tha snyad du mar 'dogs shing gnas pa ni/ rgyu ba dang / mi rgyu ba dang / bdag dang / gzhan dang / srog dang / gso ba dang / gang zag dang / byed pa po dang / shed bdag dang / shed can dang / pha dang / ma dang / bla ma dang / 'jig rten gyi mes po dang / sa dang / nam mkha' dang / me dang / rlung dang / ri bo dang / rgya mtsho dang / gling dang / nag ngam dang / shing gal pa dang / lcug ma dang / 'khril shing la sogs par gnas te/ 'di rnams kyi ngo bo las gzhan pa yod par dus gsum gyi mgon po rnams kyis ye ma gsungs la/ 'di rnams la mchog dang dman par lta ba'i skyes bu kho na kyai rdo rje yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / de bzhin du phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag nyid/ ces sogs rgyud 'grel rnams nas sems can gyi phung po khams skye mched rnams la sangs rgyas su gang gsungs pa yang gzhi'i kyai rdor 'di la dgongs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du 'di dang 'dra bar phar phyin gyi theg pa nas kyang sems can gyi sems gsal rig tu gnas pa dang / de'i chos nyid gnyis ka la de ltar du bshad de/

mdo las/ sangs rgyas kyi sku de nyid nyon mongs pa'i sbubs bye ba mtha' yas pas bstums pa/ 'khor ba'i rgyun gyis khyer ba thog ma dang / mtha' ma med pa'i 'khor ba'i 'gro bar bcings pa dang / skye ba dag tu 'khor ba ni sems can gyi khams zhes brjod do/ /zhes sems can gyi sems rang bzhin gyi chos skur bshad cing / rgyud bla ma las/ shes bya mthar thug rtogs pa'i blos/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid ni/ /sems can thams cad la yod par/ /mthong phyir ji snyed yod pa nyid/ /ces dang / yang de nyid las/ ji ltar mdog ngan pad ma'i khungs gnas pa/ /mtshan stong gi 'bar de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /dri med lha yi mig gis de mthong nas/ /chu skyes 'dab ma'i sbubs nas 'byin byed pa/ /de bzhin bde gshegs mnar med gnas rnams la'ang / /sangs rgyas spyan gyis rang chos nyid gzigs nas/ /zhes dang / 'phags pas chos dbyings bstod par/ gang zhig kun tu ma shes na/ /srid pa gsum du rnam 'khor zhing / /sems can kun la nges gnas pa'i/ /chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /ces gsungs pas/ sems can gyi sems kyi chos nyid dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la'ang chos sku'i sangs rgyas su bshad pa yin no/ /de ltar bshad pa'i snang ba dang stong pa ngo bo dbyer med pa gzhi dus kyi kyai rdo rje dang / 'khor lo bde mchog la sogs pa yin pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa las/ 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste/ /'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa nyid/ /'khor ba spangs nas gzhan du ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yang 'di la dgongs pa yin zhing / grub chen mtsho skyes kyis/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/ /kyai rdo rje bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pas kyang 'di nyid gsal bar bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa lam kyai rdo rje thabs shes zung 'jug ni/

rdo rje snying 'grel las/ bsdus pa'i rgyud 'di nyid las/ rdo rje'i tshig 'dis gsal bar rab tu bstan pa yin te/ gang du yid gyis ma bsgoms na/ /'gro ba thams cad bsgoms 'gyur te/ /sgom pa med pa'i sgom nyid kyis/ /chos rnams thams cad yongs shes bya/ /zhes bya bas gsal bar byed de/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i dbugs 'byin pa yin no/ /shes rab chen po yan lag drug gi so sor sdud pa zhes pa dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas dang / gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs par tha snyad btags pa yin la/ 'bad pa thams cad dor bas 'grub/ /ces par dgongs so/ /'di kho na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /'di nyid bdag med ma'o/ /'di nyid he ru ka'o/ /'di nyid dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas so/ /'di nyid srid pa'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu 'gro'o/ /'di nyid yi ge med pa'i don yin no/ /zhes pa ste/ nges pa'i don no/ /zhes gsungs pas shes rab kyi ldog pa nas bstan la/ de bzhin du lam gyi skabs kyi snang ba'i ldog pa ni/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba nas/ grol byed gyi lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa ji lta ba bzhin du nyams su len pa nyams myong dang bcas pa yin no/ /gsum pa 'bras bu kyai rdo rje sku gnyis zung 'jug gam/ sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan ni/ dpal sam bu ṭi las/ spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /shes rab ces ni yongs su grags/ /yid bzhin nor ltar ma lus pa'i/ /thams cad don mdzad snying rje nyid/ /dmigs med gnas su shes rab dang / /dmigs med snying rje chen po nyid/ /blo dang lhan cig gcig 'gyur pa/ /nam mkha' nam mkha' ji lta ba/ /zhes gsungs pas bstan pa yin zhing rgyas par ni gong du bstan pa ltar yin no/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bzhi dang ldan pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi lus dkyil 'khor du grub tshul bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ grub chen dril bu pas/ 'gro ba 'di dag rang bzhin gyis/

/grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa/ /zhes gsungs la/ de'i don bshad pa la gnyis/ gang gi lus dkyil 'khor du grub pa'i 'gro ba ngos bzung nas/ de'i lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor yin tshul bshad pa dang / rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor de nyid 'khor lo bde mchog la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog la sogs pa'i lam gyi snod du gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi dang ldan pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi lus 'di rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i phyi ma las/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor zhes grags dang / /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor dag /lus kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bshad pa/ /gsum po 'di dag yin par gsungs/ /zhes dang / phung po skye mched khams rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rgyas btab pa'i/ /des na brtag par rgya dgod po/ /dkyil 'khor zhes ni bstan pa yin/ /zhes dang / dpal kha sbyor las/ dkyil 'khor lus su gsungs pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor bha gar brjod pa yin/ /dkyil 'khor byang chub sems nyid de/ /dkyil 'khor gsum du rab tu brtag /ces gsungs pas/ rtsa lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor/ khams bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor dang gsum du bstan la/ de yang 'gro ba de rnams kyi lus kyi yul nyer bzhi la sogs pa'i mi phyed ma la sogs pa'i rtsa rnams ni lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ rtsa de rnams su la sogs pa'i yi ge'i gzugs su gnas pa'i dbyibs rnams yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor/ rtsa de rnams kyi nang du gnas pa'i so dang sen mo rgyas par byed pa la sogs pa'i khams rnams ni byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor yin la/ de gsum ka la yang lus zhes bya ste/ 'gro ba de rnams kyi lus kyi bye brag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de dkyil 'khor yin te/ thabs de la brten nas lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po de len pa ste/

'dzin par byed pa'i phyir te/ he badz+ra las/ dkyil 'khor snying po zhes bya ste/ /byang chub sems ni bde chen po/ /len par byed pas dkyil 'khor nyid/ /'dus pas dkyil 'khor nyid du brjod/ /ces gsungs shing / dpal kha sbyor las kyang / dngos po kun gyi snying po mchog /de ni len cing gcod pa'i phyir/ /lus ni dkyil 'khor brjod du brjod/ /rtsa chen sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /'khor lo yang ni dkyil 'khor brjod/ /byang chub sems ni rin po che/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid dkyil 'khor nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de la rang bzhin gyis grub pa zhes bya ste/ 'jig rten na me grub pa tsam nas tsha ba ngang gis grub pa la tha snyad du me'i rang bzhin tsha ba zhes brjod pa ltar/ 'dir yang / sgrub pa po la sogs pa'i 'gro ba de rnams kyi lus grub pa tsam nas dkyil 'khor gsum po de rang gi ngang gis grub pa'i phyir na de skad du brjod pa yin no/ /gsum pa rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor de nyid/ bde mchog la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du bsgrub pa ni/ de ltar bshad pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi lus la rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum po 'di ni 'khor lo bde mchog la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ de yang gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gsum las/ 'di dang po'i dbang du byas pa yin zhing / de yang bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ yul 'di rnams kyi bu mo gang / /rtsa gzugs mdzes par yang dag gnas/ /zhes dang / dpal kha sbyor gyi drug pa'i rab byed dang por/ sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhir phye ba yis/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni kun gyi gnas/ /thams cad du ni yang dag bshad/ /'di rnams gnas kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /rtsa yi gzugs kyis yang dag gnas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ spyi bo pu li ra ma la ya la sogs pa nang gi gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhir gnas pa'i rab gtum la sogs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams mi phyed ma la sogs pa'i rtsa gzugs kyis gnas par gsungs la/

de bzhin du rtsa de rnams kyi nang du gnas pa'i thig le rnams ni/ he ru ka rnams yin te/ dpal kha sbyor gyi drug pa'i rab byed gnyis par/ ji ltar gnas su son pa'i rtsa'i 'khor lo bshad par bya'o/ /snying gi nang son pad+ma ni/ /'dab ma brgyad pa snying por bcas/ /de yi nang du son pa'i rtsa/ /mar me'i rang gi ngo bo can/ /chu shing gi ni me tog ltar/ /brkyangs shing kha ni 'og tu'o/ /de yi nang na dpa' bo ni/ /yungs kar gyi ni sbom phra tsam/ /mi shig hūm̐ gi sa bon ni/ /kha ba lta bur 'dzag pa nyid/ /lus can rnams kyi snying dga' ba/ /dpyid ces bya bar rnam par bshad/ /rgod ma me yi gzugs kyi ni/ /bdag med ma yi thig ler brjod/ /las kyi rlung gis bskul ba yi/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du ni 'bar/ /dpyid thob pa yi chos shes pas/ /snyoms par 'jug par rnam par gnas/ /dpa' bo shrī ni he ru ka /'di ni dpyid dang thig ler brjod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /don 'di rnams la dgongs nas/ grub chen dril bu pas/ 'di dag gnas su mkha' 'gro ma/ /rtsa'i dpa' bo nyi shu bzhi/ /lus kyi khams su brtag par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de nyid bcom ldan 'das kyi gzhung gi don phyin ci ma log pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud kyi le'u zhe brgyad pa las/ thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yis/ /'gro ba 'di dag thams cad khyab/ /dpa' bo rnams dang mkha' 'gro nyid/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rab gtum sogs/ /lus rnams kun la sgrub pa pos/ /'khor lo bzhugs par blta bar gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des ni 'gro ba rnams kyi lus bde mchog la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du grub par bshad pa ni/ de rnams kyi gzhi dus kyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du byas pa yin no/ /gsum pa g.yo sgyu'i rtsod pa de dag rang lugs dang 'gal bar bstan pa la gnyis/ gang dang 'gal ba'i rang gi lugs brjod pa/

rtsod pa de nyid de dang 'gal tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ khyod kyis ji skad du/ nyer thob kyi mthar 'chi ba'i 'od gsal 'char ba ni 'od gsal gyi rim pa ste/ gzhi'i chos sku zhes kyang bya'o/ /'chi ba'i 'od gsal gyi mthar phung po rnying pa'i khrod na gnas pa'i rlung sems tsam las lus rnying pa las logs su bye nas bar do'i lus grub pa ni/ sgyu lus kyi rim pa ste gzhi'i chos sku zhes kyang bya'o/ /gzhi la dag ma dag gi sgyu lus kyi rim pa so so ba gnyis med kyang / 'dis lam gyi sgyu ma'i sku gnyis mtshon nus pa ni 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gzhi'i bar do longs sku mig tha mal pa sha'i mig gi yul du mi mthong ba de skye srid du skye ba blangs pa na mig de'i yul du gyur pa ni gzhi'i sprul sku'o/ /zhes bshad cing / yang rtsa ltung brgyad pa'i skabs su 'di gnyis las/ yul ni gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa'i phung po lnga ni rim pa bzhin du/ rnam snang dang / rin 'byung dang / 'od dpag med dang / don yod grub pa dang / mi bskyod pa ste sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid dam rang bzhin du gsungs so/ /zhes dang / yang 'o na dbang bzhi pa lam gyi skabs su mi 'dod dam zhe na/ spyir dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshe sngar bzhin ngo sprad nas tshig tsam gyis go ba bskyed pa la/ dbang de slob ma la bskur ba dang / slob mas dbang de tshig gi sgo nas thob par 'jog ste/ snod rung du bsgrub pa'i dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de ltar ngo sprad pa'i dbang bzhi pa ni gtso bo la ngo sprad dgos pas/ 'bras bu la ngo sprad pa sngar drangs pa mang pos gsungs kyang / lam dus su med pa min te/ gsang 'dus pa ltar na slob pa'i zung 'jug dang / dus 'khor ba ltar na ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag nas 'ong ste/ de'i rigs pas gzhan la'ang shes par bya'o/ /zhes zer ro/ /gnyis pa rtsod pa de nyid rang tshig dang 'gal tshul bshad pa ni/

de la khyod kyis gong du brjod pa'i nyon mongs pas kun nas bslangs pa'i g.yo rgyu'i rtsod pa de rnams rang tshig 'di rnams dang 'gal ba yin te/ de yang 'di ltar/ khyod kyis sems can gyi skye shi bar do gsum po dang / phung po lnga sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum dang rigs lnga'i rang bzhin yin par bshad pas/ 'di ltar smra ba ni ha cang yang ma brtags pa'i log rtog yin par khyod rang gi phyogs su thal bar 'gyur te/ de ltar na 'gro ba rnams kyi skye shi bar do gsum dang / phung po las dang nyon mongs pas bskyed pa'i du kha bden pa ma yin pa'am/ rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsum las nyon gyi dbang gis 'grub pa yod par thal/ rdo rje 'chang dngos kyang yin/ 'khor ba pa yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa yod pa'i phyir/ de tsam du yang ma zad/ 'khor ba'i du kha myong ba'i sems can yin na rdo rje 'chang yin pas khyab par 'gyur te/ skye shi bar do gsum dang phung po lnga ma thob pa'i sems can med pa la/ de ltar thob pa'i skye shi bar do gsum dang phung po lnga rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsum dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dngos yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i thal 'gyur rnams khyod la brjod pa'i tshe/ 'khor gsum po gang la lan 'debs shod cig yang khyod kyis gzhan yang de ltar 'dod pas ni sangs rgyas yin pa la yin par ngo shes phyin chad lam bsgom mi dgos pas lus dkyil lan cig brda' 'phrod phyin chad lam gang yang bsgom mi dgos par 'gyur/ zhes sogs la yang brjod par bya ste/ de yang 'di ltar khyod kyis kyang sngon gyi skye shi bar do gsum po de sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum dang / phung po lnga sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du 'dod pas sangs rgyas yin pa la yin par ngo shes phyin chad lam bsgom dgos ci yang med par 'dod dgos pas/ skye shi bar do gsum dang phung po lnga po de sku gsum dang / sangs rgyas lnga'i rang bzhin du lan gcig brda' 'phrod phyin chad/

lam gang yang bsgom mi dgos par khyod rang gi phyogs la thal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod pa'i tshe yang / 'khor gsum gang la lan 'debs shod cig des na khyod kyis kyang sems can gyi skye shi bar do gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum du smra zhing lam bsgoms nas sa lam rim can du bgrod par 'dod pa ni rig pa rnal du khyod rang gis kyang ma bzhag par 'gyur la/ yang khyod rang gis kyang phar phyin gyi lam gyi thob bya mthar thug tu bshad pa'i sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin thob kyang / da dung sngags nas bshad pa'i rdo rje 'chang las ches dman par khas blangs nas sems can thams cad kyi skye shi bar do gsum po de rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsum dngos su gdod ma nas grub par 'dod pa 'di las ngo mtshar du gyur pa ci zhig byar yod/ ces khyod rang gi phyogs la brjod na yang ci zer smros shig gal te sems can rnams kyi skye shi bar do gsum po sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum du mi gsal zhing / mngon du ma gyur pa'i tshul gyis gdod ma nas yod pa la bsgom stobs kyis mngon du gyur pa byed pa yin no zhe na/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i cha thad gdod ma nas mi gsal ba'i tshul gyis dngos su yod par 'dod pa grangs can gyi ring lugs gra ma nyams pa yin pas blo ldan rnams kyis rgyang ring du spang bar bya'o/ /yang der ma zad/ sems can thams cad kyi skye shi bar do gsum po de sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum dang / sems can rnams kyi phung po lnga po de de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du gdod ma nas dngos su yod na/ srog gcod pa'i las yin na de bzhin gshegs pa dkrongs pa'i mtshams med kyi las yin dgos par khyod rang gi phyogs la thal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod na/ 'khor gsum po gang la lan 'debs par byed/ mdor na thal 'gyur 'di rnams kyi 'khor gsum don dang mthun par khyod kyis khas len pa la bsnyon rgyu ci yod legs par smros shig

de la kho na re/ 'di rnams kyi rtsod pa spong ba na/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi dbang du byas pa yin pas skyon med do/ /zhe na/ 'o na nged kyis kyang de ltar bshad pa la skyon med par 'gyur te/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag byed pa'i dbang du byas pa yin par gong du rgyas par brjod zin pa ltar yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes brjod na ci zer/ des na gong gi rtsod pa de rnams ni rang tshig dang dngos su 'gal bas don med pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis phyi'i bskyed rim gyis brgyud nas gnad du bsnun tshul/ nang gi bskyed rim gyis dngos su gnad du bsnun tshul/ zhar byung rang nyid bsgom bya'i lha de yin min gyi dogs pa dpyad pa gsum gyi sgo nas sbyang gzhi lus la bskyed rim gyis gnad du bsnun tshul bstan zin nas/ spyi don gnyis pa sbyong byed rdzogs rim gyis sbyang gzhi'i lus la gnad du bsnun tshul bshad pa ni/ sbyang gzhi rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas tshul gyi gnad ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar dkyil 'khor gsum dang / snying po rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang bzhi po de yin la/ de la gnad du snun byed kyi rdzogs rim gyi dmigs pa ni/ bla med kyi dbang gong ma gsum gyi lam yin la/ lam de ji ltar gnad du snun par byed pa/ rten dmigs bcas kyi bsgom tshul dang / rten dmigs med kyi bsgom tshul/ de la bogs 'don cing gegs sel tshul la sogs pa lam gyi cha lag dang bcas pa/ bla med kyi rgyud sde so so'i dgongs pa grub chen rnams kyis so sor bkral pa ltar/ bla ma so so'i man ngag skyon med pa las 'byung ba bzhin nyams su blang bar bya ba ste/ rdzogs rim gyis gnad du bsnun tshul mdor bsdus pa'o/ /de dag gis ni gang la gnad du bsnun yul gyi sbyang gzhi ngos bzung ba/ bye brag tu sbyang gzhi'i gtso bo mngal skyes yin pa'i dbang du byas nas/ rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs bstan pa/

sbyang gzhi de dag sbyong byed kyi bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi sbyang gzhi'i lus la gnad du bsnun tshul bshad pa ste don tshan gsum gyi sgo nas sgro 'dogs chod pa'i rim gnyis nyams su len tshul rgyas par bstan zin to// ༈ //spyi don bzhi pa sgro 'dogs chod pa'i rim gnyis nyams su blangs pa la brten nas drod sogs kyi yon tan skye tshul bshad pa la gnyis/ drod sogs kyi yon tan mdor bsdus te bshad pa dang / sa lam gyi yon tan skye tshul rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ drod kyi ngo bo/ drod thob pa'i rtags/ drod dang spyod pa mtshams sbyor ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa las skyes pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi nus mthu khyad par can gcig la drod ces brjod pa yin no/ /gnyis pa drod thob pa'i rtags la spyi rtags dang / so so'i rtags gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spyir drod thob na/ du sogs kyi rtags lnga mthong dgos pa yin te/ rdo rje gur gyi le'u bzhi pa las/ phyag mtshan yang dag mtshon par bya/ /dang po sprin gyi rnam pa ste/ /gnyis pa dud pa 'dra ba nyid/ /gsum pa me khyer rnam pa ste/ /bzhi pa mar me nyer 'bar ba/ /lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ste/ /sprin med nam mkha' 'dra ba nyid/ /de ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu/ /dngos grub nye bar 'gyur ba yin/ /phyi nas sgyu ma'i rnam pa ltar/ /rmi lam rnam pa'i skad cig 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing / dpa' sam bu ṭa'i lnga pa'i gnyis pa las/ dang po mtshan ma thams cad kyis/ /mar me'i rnam pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa nas/ brgyad kyi rang 'dod rnal 'byor pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'bras bu'i don/ /zhes gsungs pa'i bar yin no/ /gnyis pa drod so so'i rtags la/ drod la che 'bring chung gsum du bshad pa las/ de la drod chung ngu zhes pa de thob pa na/ mnyam gzhag la 'jig rten chos brgyad mgo snyom snyam pa'i nyams skyes pa dang /

rjes thob tu nyon mongs blo bur ba drag pos mi gnod cing brtan na de drod chung ngu yin te/ dpal kha sbyor gyi lnga pa'i gsum pa'i drod chung ngu'i skabs su/ de bzhin 'jig rten chos brgyad ni/ /thams cad shin tu ring du spangs/ /zhes gsungs shing / he badz+ra'i phyi ma las 'di'i skabs su/ 'jig smyo de bzhin du kha dang / /mya ngan gdung ba 'tshe ba dang / /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che/ /sgrub pa po ni nyon mi mongs/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /drod 'bring ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis tshar gcod par nus kyang rjes su gzung bar mi nus te/ rnam shes dang ye shes kyi las cha mi mnyam pa zhes bya la de nyid brtan na drod 'bring po zhes bya ba yin no/ /drod chen po ni/ tshar gcod pa dang rjes su bzung ba gnyis ka ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas nus pa ste/ rnam shes kyi las dang ye shes kyi las cha mnyam pa zhes bya ste/ de yang nus pa de brtan na drod chen po yin no/ /de'ang drod che 'bring gnyis ka'i yon tan ston byed kyi lung / dpal brtag pa gnyis pa'i phyi ma las/ phan dang gnod pa'i 'bras 'byung bar/ /de ltar nges par shes nas ni/ /ji ltar de ni skad cig kyang / /rnal 'byor ngu 'bod ga la 'gro /zhes gsungs pas/ drod 'bring po thob nas ngan song du mi 'gro bar bshad pas phar phyin gyi theg pa'i sbyor lam bzod pa dang nges par mnyam pa yin no/ /gsum pa drod dang spyod pa'i mtshams sbyar ba bshad pa la lnga/ spyod pa'i ngo bo ngos bzung ba/ de gnyis kyi mtshams sbyar tshul dngos dang / de gnyis mtshams sbyar ba'i dgos pa bshad pa dang / drod ma thob na spyod pa byar mi rung bar bstan pa/ spyod pa la spyad na dngos grub mi thob par bstan pa'o/ /dang po spyod pa rang gi ngo bo ni/ nang du rim gnyis kyi rtogs pas kun nas bslangs pa'i phyi rol tu lus ngag g.yo zhing nges med du rgyu ba dang /

smra ba sogs la 'dir spyod pa zhes bya ste/ de'i lus kyi spyod pa la nges pa med pa ni/ dpal kha sbyor gyi lnga pa'i bzhi pa las/ ro yi dkris ma'i gos bzang dang / /ro bsregs thal bas de bzhin brgyan/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bza' ba la nges pa med pa ni/ yang des gsungs pa las/ khyi dang bong bu rnga mong dang / /glang po la sogs khrag 'thung nas/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ ji ltar rnyed pa bzhin du za/ /bzos shing zos dang gtor ma sbyin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bza' ba'i snod dang rgyu ba'i dus dang / gnas la nges pa med pa ni/ yang de nyid las/ ro yi khams phor thogs nas ni/ /mtshan mo'i dus su rgyu bar bya/ /bzhi mdo dang ni ri gdong dang / /shing gcig dang ni dur khrod du/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so/ /mdor na lus ngag gi spyod pa la/ bla ma la phyag bya ba ma gtogs bya ba gzhan la nges pa med de/ lus ngag gi dam tshig thams cad las grol ba'i phyir ro/ /bla ma la phyag bya ba ni mi spangs te/ de ni ye shes kyi dam tshig gi phyir dang / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang rang rang gi rdo rje slob dpon la phyag 'tshal bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang dpal kha sbyor gyi lnga pa'i gsum pa las/ rgyal bas mchod pa'i slob dpon ni sems can yin yang / ye shes kyi dam tshig rtag tu dngos grub sbyin par byed de/ blo dang ldan pa la phyogs bcur bzhugs pas mchod par byed do/ /gang gi phyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams gang zhig slob dpon gyi ba spu'i rtse mo la mthong ba de'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' slob dpon la sangs rgyas mchod pa byed par mthong ngo / /nges par rang gi dam tshig sangs rgyas 'dod pas dngos grub sbyin par byed pa bla ma dam pa la smad par mi bya ba dang / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa drod dang spyod pa mtshams sbyar tshul bshad pa ni/

drod chung du thob nas kun 'dar gyi spyod pa mtshan mo gsang nas spyad la/ drod 'bring po thob nas kun 'dar gyi spyod pa 'jig rten pa'i mngon du spyad do/ /drod chen po thob nas/ kun bzang gi spyod pa 'jig rten pa rnams kyis mngon sum du phyag rgya dang lhan cig tshogs bdag chen po'i spyod pa spyad pa yin no/ /gsum pa de ltar drod dang spyod pa mtshams sbyar ba'i dgos pa ni/ drod gsum gyi rtogs pa'i brtan g.yo brtag pa dang / rtog pa gsum po de mi brtan na/ brtan par byed pa dang / brtan pa bogs 'byung ba'i ched du byed pa yin no/ /bzhi pa drod ma thob na spyod pa byed mi rung bar bstan pa ni/ he ru ka mngon 'byung las/ gang zhig gnyis med mi brtan pa/ /shi nas dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de la skyob pa med pa yin/ /rnal 'byor med par rnal 'byor rtsal/ /phyag rgya la ni bgrod gyur dang / /ye shes med par ye shes rtsal/ /dmyal bar 'gro bar the tshom med/ /ces gsungs shing / dpal gsang ba grub pa las/ gang phyir de nyid med bzhin du/ /ngo mtshar che ba ltar byed pa/ /ji srid nam mkha' mi 'jig pa/ /shi ba'i 'og tu dmyal bar skye/ /zhes gsungs shing / yang de nyid las/ gzhan du de nyid dman pa yis/ /'tshe ba'i rgyu can nyid gyur pa/ /dmyal ba thob par byed pa'i rgyu/ /brtul zhugs kyis ni ci zhig bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa spyod pa ma spyad na dngos grub mi thob par bstan pa ni/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ de'i don yang rtsa ba'i rgyud nyid la 'jug par gsungs te/ ji skad du/ cho ga yan lag kun ldan yang / /spyod pa ma brtsams dngos grub med/ /de bas phyag rgya'i dngos grub rgyu/ /chags med spyod pa 'di yin no/ /snying rjes rnam par chags tsam gyis/ /sems can don gyis spyod mi 'grub/ /de bas snying rje dang ldan zhing / /'bad pas spyod pa spyad par bya/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag gis ni drod sogs kyi yon tan mdor bsdus te bstan zin nas// ༈ //spyi don gnyis pa sa lam gyi yon tan rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ sa lam gyi yon tan byang phyogs so bdun dang sbyar tshul bshad pa dang / sa'i rnam gzhag bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ thun mong ba phar phyin gyi theg pa'i lugs kyis lam lnga byang phyogs so bdun dang sbyar tshul bshad pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa bla med kyi lugs kyis bden pa mthong ba dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa'i bar byang phyogs so bdun dang sbyar nas bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ tshogs lam chung ngu la dran pa nye bar zhes bzhag pa bzhi/ 'bring po na yang dag par spong ba bzhi/ chen po na rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ste/ chos bcu gnyis tshogs lam gyis bsdus la/ de'i rjes su dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga sbyor lam gyi skabs nas thob pas 'jig rten pa'i lam bya'o/ /de nas mthong lam la byang chub kyi yan lag bdun/ sgom lam la 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad thob par bshad pas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam zhes bya ba'o/ /mthar phyin pa'i lam ni de rnams kyi 'bras bu yin pas lam du btags pa'o/ /'di ltar du bshad pa ni phar phyin dang sngags kyi theg pa phal cher nas 'byung ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ dpal sam bu ṭa'i rab byed gnyis pa las/ thog mar byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun bshad pa'i rjes thog de ma thag tu/ de nyid yang dag bshad pa ni/ /dga' ba la sogs sa rnams te/ /dbang po la sogs rang bzhin gyis/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gnas/ /phung po la sogs khyad par gyis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni mchog tu 'bab/ /byang sems sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis/ /gang tshe 'dir ni gang gyur pa/ /dbang po phung po 'byung ba yis/ /sangs rgyas de yi de ma thag

/ces gsungs pas de'i don ni/ byang phyogs so bdun po de dag bden pa mthong ba nas bzung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi sa mngon du byas kyi bar la sbyar ba dang / sbyang gzhi rgyu rgyud rtsa khams sogs la sbyar ba dang / sbyong byed lam gyi bskyed rdzogs gnyis la sbyar ba dang / sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gzugs sku la sbyar ba bzhir gnas pa las/ 'dir skabs su babs pa'i don ni dang po yin la/ de'i don cung zad cig brjod pa ni rgyud kyis/ de nyid ces pas/ de nyid ces bya ba gong du bshad pa'i byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun po de nyid do/ /zhes yang dag par bshad pa ni rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu thams cad byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun der 'dus zhes bya ba'i don yin no/ /de ji ltar 'dus zhe na dga' ba la sogs sa rnams te/ /zhes smros pas/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba nas bzung ste/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bar gyi sa rnams yin no/ /de rnams byang phyogs so bdun dang sbyor tshul ni/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba la dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ sa gnyis pa la yang dag par spongs ba bzhi/ sa gsum pa nas bzung ste sa bcu pa'i bar du byang chub kyi rim pa gnyis gnyis kyi sa re re bsgrod pas/ sa bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa gnyis la byang chub kyi yan lag bzhi bzhi yin no/ /mjug tu byang chub kyi yan lag lnga dang / drug pa'i cha gcig gis bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa bskyed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa sa'i rnam gzhag bye brag tu rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ rdo rje theg pa'i sa'i rnam gzhag gtso bor bshad pa dang / phar phyin gyi theg pa'i sa'i rnam gzhag zhar la bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ gzhan gyi log rtog dgag pa dang / rang lugs bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ gzhan gyi log rtog gi ngag brjod pa dang / de mi 'thad par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bcu gcig pa kun tu 'od kyi sa kho na sangs rgyas kyi sar bsgrub par 'dod pa'i rang phyogs pa kha cig dang /
